import-polynomial-pl050 \(f(x)\) is a cubic polynomial divisible by \(x-1\). when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(3x^{2}-x-2\), the remainder is \(5x+k\), where \(k\) is a constant.

(a) find \(k\).

(b) it is given that \(3x-1\) is a factor of \(f(x)\). when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x+2\), the remainder is \(-63\). someone claims that all the roots of the equation \(f(x)=0\) are different in values. is the claim correct? explain your answer. 三次多項式 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x-1\) 整除。當 \(f(x)\) 被 \(3x^2-x-2\) 除時,餘式為 \(5x+k\)。

(a) 求 \(k\)。

(b) 已知 \(3x-1\) 是因式,且 \(f(-2)=-63\),所有根是否互異? extra pdf · s4 polynomials review · p1 q17 來源所列(未獨立核實):extra pdf · s4 polynomials review · p1 q17 dividend = divisor × quotient + remainder / 被除式恆等式

import-polynomial-pl051 the cubic polynomial \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(x+1\). when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x^{2}-1\), the remainder is \(4x+k\), where \(k\) is a constant.

(a) find \(k\).

(b) it is given that \(x-2\) is a factor of \(f(x)\). when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x\), the remainder is \(4\). someone claims that all the roots of the equation \(f(x)=0\) are distinct. is the claim correct? explain your answer. 三次多項式 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x+1\) 整除。當 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x^2-1\) 除時餘式為 \(4x+k\)。

(a) 求 \(k\)。

(b) 已知 \(x-2\) 是因式及 \(f(0)=4\),所有根是否互異? extra pdf · s4 polynomials review · p1 q18 來源所列(未獨立核實):extra pdf · s4 polynomials review · p1 q18 combine remainder and factor conditions / 聯立餘式與因式條件

import-polynomial-pl052 a cubic polynomial \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(x-2\). when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x^{2}-4\), the remainder is \(kx-42\), where \(k\) is a constant.

(a) find \(k\).

(b) it is given that \(x-1\) is a factor of \(f(x)\). when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x-3\), the remainder is \(16\). a student claims that all roots of \(f(x)\) are integers. do you agree? explain your answer. 三次多項式 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x-2\) 整除。當 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x^2-4\) 除時餘式為 \(kx-42\)。

(a) 求 \(k\)。

(b) 已知 \(x-1\) 是因式且 \(f(3)=16\),所有根是否全為整數(integers)? extra pdf · s4 polynomials review · p1 q20 來源所列(未獨立核實):extra pdf · s4 polynomials review · p1 q20 combine remainder and factor conditions / 聯立餘式與因式條件

import-polynomial-pl053 the cubic polynomial \(\mathrm{f}(x)\) is divisible by \(x-2\). when \(\mathrm{f}(x)\) is divided by \(x^{2}-4\), the remainder is \(k x+24\), where \(k\) is a constant.

(a) find \(k\).

(3 marks)

(b) it is given that \(x+1\) is a factor of \(\mathrm{f}(x)\). when \(\mathrm{f}(x)\) is divided by \(x\), the remainder is 8 . someone claims that all the roots of the equation \(\mathrm{f}(x)=0\) are integers. is the claim correct? explain your answer.

(5 marks) 三次多項式 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x-2\) 整除。當 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x^2-4\) 除時,餘式為 \(kx+24\),其中 \(k\) 為常數。

(a) 求 \(k\)。

(b) 已知 \(x+1\) 是 \(f(x)\) 的因式,且 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x\) 除時餘式為 \(8\)。有人聲稱 \(f(x)=0\) 的所有根都是整數。該聲稱是否正確?解釋你的答案。 mock 2324 · ywgs · p1 q13 來源所列(未獨立核實):mock 2324 · ywgs · p1 q13 combine remainder and factor conditions / 聯立餘式與因式條件

import-polynomial-pl054 let \(\mathrm{g}(x)=3 x^{3}+a x^{2}+b x+c\), where \(a, b\) and \(c\) are constants. when \(\mathrm{g}(x)\) is divided by \(x^{2}-4\), the remainder is \(k x-36\), where \(k\) is a constant. it is given that \(\mathrm{g}(x)\) is divisible by \(x-2\).

(a) find \(k\).

(b) when \(\mathrm{g}(x)\) is divided by \(x\), the remainder is 8 . how many rational roots does the equation \(g(x)=0\) have? explain your answer. 設 \(g(x)=3x^3+ax^2+bx+c\),其中 \(a,b,c\) 為常數。當 \(g(x)\) 被 \(x^2-4\) 除時,餘式為 \(kx-36\),其中 \(k\) 為常數。已知 \(g(x)\) 可被 \(x-2\) 整除。

(a) 求 \(k\)。

(b) 當 \(g(x)\) 被 \(x\) 除時,餘式為 \(8\)。方程 \(g(x)=0\) 有多少個有理根?解釋答案。 mock 2425 · chalet · p1 q14 來源所列(未獨立核實):mock 2425 · chalet · p1 q14 factorise then classify roots / 因式分解及根的性質

import-polynomial-pl055 the polynomial \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(2x^2-x-3\). when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x^2-x-1\), the quotient and the remainder are \(2x^2-px+3\) and \(6x-q\) respectively, where \(p\) and \(q\) are constants.

(a) find \(p\) and \(q\). (3 marks)

(b) how many rational roots does the equation \(f(x)=0\) have? explain your answer. (3 marks) \(f(x)\) 可被 \(2x^2-x-3\) 整除。當 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x^2-x-1\) 除時,商式及餘式為 \(2x^2-px+3\) 及 \(6x-q\)。

(a) 求 \(p,q\)。

(b) \(f(x)=0\) 有多少個有理根? mock 2526 · hkugac · p1 q11 來源所列(未獨立核實):mock 2526 · hkugac · p1 q11 factorise then classify roots / 因式分解及根的性質

import-polynomial-pl056 let \(f(x)\) be a cubic polynomial. when \(f(x)\) is divided by \((x+2)(x-3)\), the quotient and remainder are \(ax+1\) and \(6x+k\) respectively. \(x+2\) is a factor of \(f(x)\).

(a) find the value of \(k\).

(b) when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(2x-1\), the remainder is \(\frac{5}{2}\). how many rational roots does the equation \(f(x)=0\) have? explain your answer. 設 \(f(x)\) 為三次多項式。當 \(f(x)\) 被 \((x+2)(x-3)\) 除時,商式及餘式分別為 \(ax+1\) 及 \(6x+k\),其中 \(a,k\) 為常數。已知 \(x+2\) 是 \(f(x)\) 的因式。

(a) 求 \(k\)。

(b) 當 \(f(x)\) 被 \(2x-1\) 除時,餘式為 \(\frac{5}{2}\)。方程 \(f(x)=0\) 有多少個有理根?解釋你的答案。 extra pdf · polynomials reviews 4 · p1 q13 來源所列(未獨立核實):extra pdf · polynomials reviews 4 · p1 q13 factorise then classify roots / 因式分解及根的性質

import-polynomial-pl057 let \(f(x)\) be a polynomial. when \(f(x)\) is divided by \((x+1)(x-2)\), the remainder is \(3x-1\).

(a) find \(f(-1)\).

(b) let \(g(x)=f(x)+ax^{2}+bx+2\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are constants. when \(g(x)\) is divided by \(x+1\), the remainder is \(8\). it is given that \(f(x)\) and \(g(x)\) are both divisible by \(2x-1\). find \(a\) and \(b\). \(f(x)\) 被 \((x+1)(x-2)\) 除時餘式為 \(3x-1\)。

(a) 求 \(f(-1)\)。

(b) 設 \(g(x)=f(x)+ax^2+bx+2\)。已知 \(g(x)\) 被 \(x+1\) 除時餘式為 \(8\),且 \(f,g\) 均可被 \(2x-1\) 整除,求 \(a,b\)。 extra pdf · polynomials reviews3 · p1 q4 來源所列(未獨立核實):extra pdf · polynomials reviews3 · p1 q4 combine remainder and factor conditions / 聯立餘式與因式條件

import-polynomial-pl058 let \(f(x)\) be a cubic polynomial. when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(2x^{2}+3x+1\), the remainder is \(4x+4\).

(a) find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(2x+1\).

(b) when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(2x^{2}-x-1\), the remainder is \(kx+12\).

(i) find \(k\).

(ii) when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x\), the remainder is \(7\). find \(f(x)\).

(iii) someone claims that all the roots of \(f(x)+7x+7=0\) are real roots. do you agree? explain your answer. 設 \(f(x)\) 為三次多項式。當 \(f(x)\) 被 \(2x^{2}+3x+1\) 除時,餘式為 \(4x+4\)。

(a) 求 \(f(x)\) 被 \(2x+1\) 除的餘式。

(b) 當 \(f(x)\) 被 \(2x^{2}-x-1\) 除時,餘式為 \(kx+12\)。

(i) 求 \(k\)。

(ii) 已知 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x\) 除的餘式為 \(7\),求 \(f(x)\)。

(iii) 有人聲稱方程 \(f(x)+7x+7=0\) 的所有根都是實根。你是否同意?解釋你的答案。 extra pdf · polynomial hell · p1 q14 來源所列(未獨立核實):extra pdf · polynomial hell · p1 q14 factorise then classify roots / 因式分解及根的性質

import-polynomial-pl059 let \(f(x)\) be a cubic polynomial. when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(2x^2-7x-4\), the remainder is \(2x-k-3\), where \(k\) is a constant. it is given that \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(2x+1\). when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(2x-7\), the remainder is \(4\). the constant term of \(f(x)\) is \(25\).

(a) find \(k\).

(b) find the quotient when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(2x^2-7x-4\).

(c) how many irrational roots does \(f(x)=0\) have? explain your answer. 設 \(f(x)\) 為三次多項式。當 \(f(x)\) 被 \(2x^2-7x-4\) 除時,餘式為 \(2x-k-3\),其中 \(k\) 為常數。已知 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(2x+1\) 整除。當 \(f(x)\) 被 \(2x-7\) 除時,餘式為 \(4\),而 \(f(x)\) 的常數項為 \(25\)。

(a) 求 \(k\)。

(b) 求 \(f(x)\) 被 \(2x^2-7x-4\) 除時的商式。

(c) 方程 \(f(x)=0\) 有多少個無理根?解釋你的答案。 extra pdf · polynomials reviews 4 · p1 q18 來源所列(未獨立核實):extra pdf · polynomials reviews 4 · p1 q18 factorise then classify roots / 因式分解及根的性質

import-polynomial-pl060 let \(f(x)=6x^3+5x^2+kx-8\). when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(3x^2+ax+2\), the quotient and the remainder are \(2x+b\) and \(cx-6\) respectively, where \(a,b,c\) are constants.

(a) find \(a\).

(b) let \(g(x)\) be a cubic polynomial such that when \(g(x)\) is divided by \(3x^2+ax+2\), the remainder is \(cx-6\).

(i) prove that \(f(x)-g(x)\) is divisible by \(3x^2+ax+2\).

(ii) someone claims that all roots of \(f(x)-g(x)=0\) are real numbers. do you agree? explain your answer. 設 \(f(x)=6x^3+5x^2+kx-8\)。\(f(x)\) 被 \(3x^2+ax+2\) 除時商式及餘式分別為 \(2x+b,cx-6\)。

(a) 求 \(a\)。

(b) \(g(x)\) 被同一除式後餘式也為 \(cx-6\)。

(i) 證明 \(f-g\) 可被該除式整除。

(ii) \(f-g=0\) 的所有根是否皆為實數? extra pdf · polynomials reviewss · p1 q3 來源所列(未獨立核實):extra pdf · polynomials reviewss · p1 q3 factorise then classify roots / 因式分解及根的性質

import-polynomial-pl061 let \(p(x)\) be a polynomial and let \(k\) be a real constant. when \(p(x)\) is divided by \((x-3)^2\), the remainder is \(26kx-204\). when \(p(x)\) is divided by \(x^2+2x-15\), the remainder is \(k(10x-3)\).

(a) find \(k\).

(b) it is known that

\[
p(x)=2x^3+q(x),
\]

where \(q(x)\) is a quadratic polynomial. how many rational roots does the equation \(q(x)=0\) have? explain your answer. 設 \(p(x)\) 為多項式,而 \(k\) 為實數常數。當 \(p(x)\) 被 \((x-3)^2\) 除時,餘式為 \(26kx-204\);當 \(p(x)\) 被 \(x^2+2x-15\) 除時,餘式為 \(k(10x-3)\)。

(a) 求 \(k\)。

(b) 已知

\[
p(x)=2x^3+q(x),
\]

其中 \(q(x)\) 為二次多項式。方程 \(q(x)=0\) 有多少個有理根?解釋答案。 mock 2526 · kingsley · p1 q13 來源所列(未獨立核實):mock 2526 · kingsley · p1 q13 factorise then classify roots / 因式分解及根的性質

import-polynomial-pl062 let \(g(x)=x^3+ax^2-4x+1\) and \(h(x)=2x^4+bx^3-23x^2+12x+c\), where \(a\), \(b\) and \(c\) are constants. when \(h(x)\) is divided by \(g(x)\), the quotient and the remainder are \(mx-n\) and \(-mx+n\) respectively, where \(m\) and \(n\) are constants.

(a) find \(m\) and \(n\). (3 marks)

(b) someone claims that all the roots of the equation \(h(x)=0\) are rational numbers. do you agree? explain your answer. (4 marks) 設 \(g(x)=x^3+ax^2-4x+1\),\(h(x)=2x^4+bx^3-23x^2+12x+c\)。當 \(h(x)\) 被 \(g(x)\) 除時,商式及餘式分別為 \(mx-n\) 及 \(-mx+n\)。

(a) 求 \(m,n\)。

(b) \(h(x)=0\) 的所有根是否皆為有理數(rational numbers)? mock 2526 · tkpss · p1 q12 來源所列(未獨立核實):mock 2526 · tkpss · p1 q12 factorise then classify roots / 因式分解及根的性質

import-polynomial-pl063 let

\[
f(x)=2x^4+ax^3+5x^2+bx+c,
\]

where \(a\), \(b\) and \(c\) are constants. define

\[
g(x)=x^3-3x^2+x+1.
\]

when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(g(x)\), the sum of the quotient and the remainder is equal to 0.

(a) find the quotient when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(g(x)\). (3 marks)

(b) how many rational roots does the equation

\[
f(x)=0
\]

have? explain your answer. (4 marks) 設 \(f(x)=2x^4+ax^3+5x^2+bx+c\),\(g(x)=x^3-3x^2+x+1\)。\(f(x)\) 被 \(g(x)\) 除時,商式和餘式之和為 \(0\)。

(a) 求商式。

(b) \(f(x)=0\) 有多少個有理根? mock 2526 · shcc · p1 q14 來源所列(未獨立核實):mock 2526 · shcc · p1 q14 factorise then classify roots / 因式分解及根的性質

import-polynomial-pl064 define \(f(x)=21x^3-2x^2-8x-2\). let

\[
g(x)=ax^4-33x^3+bx^2+8x+c,
\]

where \(a\), \(b\) and \(c\) are constants. when \(g(x)\) is divided by \(f(x)\), the quotient is \(q(x)\) and the remainder is \(r(x)\).

it is given that \(r(x)=2q(x)\).

(a) find the quotient and the remainder when \(g(x)\) is divided by \(f(x)\). (3 marks)

(b) someone claims that the equation \(g(x)=0\) has two irrational roots. is the claim correct? explain your answer. (4 marks) 設 \(f(x)=21x^3-2x^2-8x-2\),\(g(x)=ax^4-33x^3+bx^2+8x+c\)。\(g(x)\) 被 \(f(x)\) 除時,餘式\(r(x)=2q(x)\),其中 \(q(x)\) 為商式。

(a) 求 \(q,r\)。

(b) \(g(x)=0\) 是否有兩個無理根? mock 2526 · spslt · p1 q12 來源所列(未獨立核實):mock 2526 · spslt · p1 q12 factorise then classify roots / 因式分解及根的性質

import-polynomial-pl065 let \(m\) and \(n\) be positive integers. if the remainder of dividing \(f(x)=x^{3}-2x^{2}-8x+n\) by \(x-m\) is \(-5\), and the remainders of dividing \(f(x)\) by \(x+m\) and \(x-2m\) are equal, find the value of \(n\). 設 \(m,n\) 為正整數。若

\[
f(x)=x^3-2x^2-8x+n
\]

被 \(x-m\) 除時餘式為 \(-5\),而 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x+m\) 及 \(x-2m\) 除時的餘式相等,求 \(n\)。 extra pdf · polynomials reviews · p1 q15 來源所列(未獨立核實):extra pdf · polynomials reviews · p1 q15 evaluate at the divisor root / 代入除式零點

import-polynomial-pl066 let \(f(x)=(x+h)^2(x-1)+k\), where \(h\) and \(k\) are constants. when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x-1\), the remainder is \(6\). given that \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(x+5\).

(a) find \(h\) and \(k\).

(b) let \(h\) be the smaller value obtained in (a). someone claims that all roots of the equation \(f(x)=0\) are rational numbers. do you agree? explain your answer. 設

\[
f(x)=(x+h)^2(x-1)+k,
\]

其中 \(h,k\) 為常數。當 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x-1\) 除時,餘式為 \(6\)。已知 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x+5\) 整除。

(a) 求 \(h,k\)。

(b) 取 \(a\) 中較小的 \(h\) 值。有人聲稱方程 \(f(x)=0\) 的所有根均為有理數。你是否同意?解釋你的答案。 extra pdf · s4 polynomials review 2 · p1 q16 來源所列(未獨立核實):extra pdf · s4 polynomials review 2 · p1 q16 factorise then classify roots / 因式分解及根的性質

import-polynomial-pl067 let \(f(x)=2x^3-x^2+ax+b\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are real constants. it is given that \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(x+2\). when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x+1\), the remainder is \(10\).

(a) find the values of \(a\) and \(b\).

(b) susan claims that \(f(n)f(n+1)\) is even for any integer \(n\). do you agree? explain your answer. 設 \(f(x)=2x^3-x^2+ax+b\),其中 \(a,b\) 為實數。已知 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x+2\) 整除,而 \(f(x)\) 被 \(x+1\) 除時餘式為 \(10\)。

(a) 求 \(a,b\)。

(b) susan 聲稱:對任何整數 \(n\),\(f(n)f(n+1)\) 必為偶數。你是否同意?解釋你的答案。 extra pdf · polynomials reviews 5 · p1 q4 來源所列(未獨立核實):extra pdf · polynomials reviews 5 · p1 q4 remainder for a quadratic divisor / 二次除式餘式

import-polynomial-pl068 let \(f(x)=(x-a)(x-b)(x+1)-2\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are positive integers with \(a\lt b\). it is given that \(f(1)=2\).

(a)(i) prove that \((a-1)(b-1)=2\).

(ii) write down the values of \(a\) and \(b\).

(b) let \(g(x)=x^3-6x^2+kx-2\), where \(k\) is a constant. use the results of (a)(ii), find the value(s) of \(k\) such that the equation \(f(x)=g(x)\) has two equal roots. 設

\[
f(x)=(x-a)(x-b)(x+1)-2,
\]

其中 \(a,b\) 為正整數且 \(a\lt b\)。已知 \(f(1)=2\)。

(a)(i) 證明 \((a-1)(b-1)=2\)。

(ii) 寫出 \(a,b\) 的值。

(b) 設 \(g(x)=x^3-6x^2+kx-2\),其中 \(k\) 為常數。利用 (a)(ii) 的結果,求 \(k\) 的值,使方程 \(f(x)=g(x)\) 有兩個相等根。 extra pdf · s4 polynomials review 2 · p1 q14 來源所列(未獨立核實):extra pdf · s4 polynomials review 2 · p1 q14 evaluate at the divisor root / 代入除式零點

import-polynomial-pl069 let \(f(x)\) be a polynomial of degree \(4\). it is given that \(f(x)\) is divisible by \((x-3)^2\). the remainders when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x-2\), \(x+1\) and \(x\) are \(4\), \(256\) and \(54\) respectively.

(a) factorize \(f(x)\).

(b) someone claims that the roots of the equation

\[
f(x)=(3x^2-7x+6)(2x-3)
\]

are all rational. do you agree? explain your answer. 設 \(f(x)\) 為四次多項式。已知 \(f(x)\) 可被 \((x-3)^2\) 整除。當 \(f(x)\) 分別被 \(x-2\)、\(x+1\) 及 \(x\) 除時,餘式為 \(4\)、\(256\) 及 \(54\)。

(a) 因式分解 \(f(x)\)。

(b) 有人聲稱方程

\[
f(x)=(3x^2-7x+6)(2x-3)
\]

的所有根都是有理數。你是否同意?解釋你的答案。 mock 2324 · bbss · p1 q11 來源所列(未獨立核實):mock 2324 · bbss · p1 q11 combine remainder and factor conditions / 聯立餘式與因式條件

import-polynomial-pl070 let \(p(x)\) be a cubic polynomial. when \(p(x)\) is divided by \(3-x\), the remainder is \(42\). when \(p(x)\) is divided by \(x+2\), the remainder is \(-248\). it is given that \(p(x)\) is divisible by \(3x^2-5x+9\).

(a) find the quotient when \(p(x)\) is divided by \(3x^2-5x+9\).

(b) solve \(p(x)=0\).

(c) someone claims that \(p(x+k)=0\) must have a rational root for any real number \(k\). do you agree? explain your answer. 設 \(p(x)\) 為三次多項式。當 \(p(x)\) 被 \(3-x\) 除時,餘式為 \(42\);當 \(p(x)\) 被 \(x+2\) 除時,餘式為 \(-248\)。已知 \(p(x)\) 可被 \(3x^2-5x+9\) 整除。

(a) 求 \(p(x)\) 被 \(3x^2-5x+9\) 除時的商式。

(b) 解方程 \(p(x)=0\)。

(c) 有人聲稱:對任意實數 \(k\),方程 \(p(x+k)=0\) 必有一個有理根。你是否同意?解釋你的答案。 extra pdf · polynomials reviews 4 · p1 q16 來源所列(未獨立核實):extra pdf · polynomials reviews 4 · p1 q16 factorise then classify roots / 因式分解及根的性質

import-polynomial-pl071 let \(f(x)=x^3+ax^2+bx+15\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are real constants. it is given that the highest common factor of \(f(x)\) and \((x+1)(x-2)(x-3)\) is of degree \(2\).
